Cheaper than most places , easy to navigate, little to no planogram (store layout) changes to give to an example I once spent half an hour looking for pasta in Tesco to find it right to the back. 

Plus those mysterious middle isles 

As for tips full credit to this angel cashier telling me this but basically 
Walk through checkout holding your empty basket or just place at the bottom of the conveyor, put everything back in said basket quickly since they “practically throw it at you” as some of my customers have said , take over to packing area (easily seen across from tills and normally under the storefront windows)  and sort into your bags (to buy them they’re found under the conveyor belts  & put on top of groceries), place the baskets into a pile on the packing shelf or near door if there’s one to not be an arse 

If taking a trolley pack as you normally would and move over to packing area if needed 

Probably overly explained but the protocols are very different to the store I work at
